system.description:
Play the Priest if you want to inspire and protect your allies through unwavering conviction.

Features

Zealous Indictment. You may make a Charm action roll against an adversary. On a success, you create an opening or distraction. The next time an ally strikes them before the end of the scene, they deal an additional 1d8 damage.

Steadfast Presence. Once per Rest, you can spend a Creed die to clear a number of HP or Stress equal to its value to yourself and all allies within Close range.
